Embed a child graph under a stable mount path for topology, rendering and checkpoints.
This package module operation uses the existing mount records (D189); it does not connect
graph execution domains. Duplicate sibling paths and empty paths are refused.

## Import

```ts
import { topology } from "@graphrefly/ts/graph";
```

## Signature

```ts
namespace topology {
	function mount(
		parent: Graph,
		child: Graph,
		at: string,
	): void
}
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `parent` | `Graph` | Graph that owns the mount record. |
| `child` | `Graph` | Child graph to mount. |
| `at` | `string` | Non-empty path unique among the parent's mounts. |

## Returns

Nothing; updates the existing mount records.

## Example

```ts
const parent = graph(), child = graph({ name: "orders" });
topology.mount(parent, child, "orders");
```
